summary: Add a collapsible shared console toolbar. API impact: none; display-only toggle retains existing console connections and contracts.

guide.reason: Document arrow, retained controls, connection and default expanded state.

api.reason: UI toggle changes no client request, Controller console ticket, console.open agent command, socket attachment, RFB result stream or Core-local authenticated console contract.

roadmap.reason: Small console presentation improvement does not change milestone scope or acceptance status.

state.reason: Only transient component display state; no durable pool setting or Controller record.

verification.method: Built-UI browser interaction with simulated API/RFB, capture review, independent code review, typecheck/build and documentation/privacy checks.
